_comment: Copy to /etc/patreon/config.json and edit. Secrets do NOT go here -- the Gmail app password is read from the environment only (see patreon.env.example).
_transcription: Both artefacts are uploaded by default, so you can hand Gemini either the video or the transcript. Set upload_media false for a transcript-only archive (megabytes instead of terabytes); set transcribe false to skip Whisper entirely.
_vocabulary: Fed to Whisper as initial_prompt. THE highest-leverage setting for jargon: without it tickers and options terms come back mangled. Edit to match what you actually archive.
